title: Senior Manager, MarTech (FRWD)
description: Senior Manager, Marketing (FRWD) – MarTechRegion: New Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru WHAT MAKES US A GREAT PLACE TO WORKWe are proud to be consistently recognized as one of the world's best places to work. Extraordinary teams are at the heart of our business strategy, but these do not happen by chance. They require intentional focus on bringing together a broad set of backgrounds, cultures, experiences, perspectives, and skills in a supportive and inclusive work environment. We hire people with exceptional talent and create an environment in which every individual can thrive professionally and personally. WHO YOU'LL WORK WITHFRWD is Bain & Company's marketing acceleration capability—a community of expert practitioners who partner with clients and their agencies to drive meaningful business results and transformation.Our team brings together specialists from leading in-house marketing organizations, agencies and technology platforms who combine deep practical expertise with a passion for measurable results. We don't just help clients determine what to do—we work alongside them to define how to make it happen.FRWD partners with Bain clients across a range of strategic marketing challenges, including:Marketing diagnostics to identify performance improvement opportunitiesMarketing transformation and capability buildingE-commerce acceleration across retail, marketplace and direct-to-consumer channelsMarketing operating model, MarTech and data strategy designCommercial due diligence and value creation planning for private equity investments WHERE YOU'LL FIT WITHIN THE TEAMWe're looking for a Senior Manager, MarTech to join FRWD in APAC.You'll bring broad marketing expertise together with deep MarTech experience, helping clients integrate technology, customer data and digital capabilities into larger marketing, commercial and growth transformations.As a senior practitioner and workstream leader, you'll shape MarTech strategies, operating models and implementation roadmaps while partnering closely with Bain consulting teams, FRWD practitioners and senior client stakeholders across marketing, sales, technology, analytics and digital functions.You'll also play an important role in growing Bain's MarTech capability across the APAC region through thought leadership, coaching and business development. WHAT YOU'LL DOLead MarTech strategy and client deliveryLead MarTech diagnostics, assessments and client workstreams across marketing technology, CRM, CDP, marketing automation, personalization, customer journey orchestration, analytics, attribution, privacy and AI-enabled marketing capabilities.Develop data-driven recommendations, investment cases, implementation of roadmaps and capability-building plans that connect technology decisions with measurable business outcomes.Assess existing MarTech ecosystems, vendor landscapes, organizational models and operating processes to identify opportunities for simplification, optimization and growth.Design customer data and activation strategies across leading platforms including Adobe Experience Cloud, Marketo, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, HubSpot, Braze, Segment/Twilio, Amplitude, Google Analytics 4, AppsFlyer and related technologies.Develop measurement frameworks, experimentation strategies and attribution approaches that improve customer acquisition, retention, lifecycle engagement and marketing ROI.Collaborate closely with client implementation teams, agencies, platform partners and Bain technical specialists, translating complex technical concepts into actionable business recommendations.Build trusted client relationshipsDevelop strong relationships with senior client stakeholders across marketing, growth, digital, technology, sales and executive leadership.Facilitate executive workshops and stakeholder interviews to align priorities and define practical transformation roadmaps.Deliver clear, compelling presentations that connect MarTech investments to commercial performance, customer experience and operating model improvements.Ensure all analyses, recommendations and client deliverables meet Bain's high standards for quality, accuracy and impact.Lead teams and grow the FRWD capabilityLead and coach integrated Bain and FRWD teams throughout client engagements.Share MarTech expertise across the broader Bain ecosystem through tools, methodologies, training and case examples.Support capability building, recruiting, intellectual property development and business development across the APAC FRWD practice.Foster a collaborative, feedback-rich culture while modeling Bain's values and leadership expectations. ABOUT YOUYou are an experienced MarTech leader who combines strategic thinking with hands-on experience delivering marketing transformation.Required Qualifications5–8 years of experience across marketing, digital, growth, marketing operations or MarTech, with demonstrated leadership progression.5+ years of experience in MarTech strategy, technology stack assessments, CRM, CDP, marketing automation, customer journey orchestration, measurement, attribution or marketing technology investments.Experience in consulting, agencies, in-house marketing, customer data or marketing technology environments; client services experience is strongly preferred.Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to connect technology, data and process decisions to commercial outcomes.Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional teams across marketing, technology, analytics and business stakeholders.Practical experience with leading MarTech platforms such as Adobe Experience Cloud, Marketo, Salesforce, HubSpot, Braze, Segment/Twilio, Amplitude, Google Analytics 4, AppsFlyer and related customer data and marketing automation technologies.Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage both executive business leaders and technical stakeholders.Experience working across APAC markets or the ability to navigate diverse regulatory environments, partner ecosystems and client cultures.Bachelor's degree required; MBA or other advanced degree preferred.Willingness to travel as required.MarTech capabilities we're seekingWhile candidates are not expected to have expertise across every platform, we value experience in several of the following areas:MarTech strategy, technology stack assessments and roadmap developmentCustomer data platforms (CDP), CRM, identity resolution, segmentation and customer activationMarketing automation, lifecycle marketing, personalization and journey orchestrationMarketing measurement, attribution, experimentation and performance analyticsPrivacy, consent management, AI-enabled marketing, workflow automation, e-commerce, retail media and AdTech integrationCertifications or practitioner experience across platforms such as Adobe Experience Cloud, Marketo, Salesforce, HubSpot, Braze, Google Marketing Platform, Meta, Amazon Ads, The Trade Desk, Segment/Twilio, Amplitude or comparable technologies ABOUT BAIN & COMPANYBain & Company is a global consultancy that helps the world's most ambitious change makers define the future.We work alongside our clients as one team with a shared ambition to achieve extraordinary results, outperform the competition and redefine industries. Our vibrant ecosystem of digital innovators complements our integrated consulting expertise to deliver better, faster and more enduring outcomes.Since 1973, we have measured our success by the success of our clients and continue to lead the industry in client advocacy.
